programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Face Painting Badge - EP 2
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Transport Badge - EP 3
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge - EP 4
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge - EP 5
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge - EP 6
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - I'm Hungry - EP 5
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Potato Time - EP 6
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Song of Peace - EP 7
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Squirrel Babies - EP 8
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with, Hennie bounces around in new dance shoes, and Happy loves water as much as Roly loves potatoes!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ladybird's Gameshow - EP 9
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Listen - EP 88
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po take it in turns to listen to music through a pair of headphones. The Teletubbies love dancing to the music they hear.

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! S01 - Peekaboo - EP 2
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are back together like you've never seen them before!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Puppets - EP 29
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Turtle Boy - EP 30
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says it's not the right thing to do.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Onesies - EP 31
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Tradies - EP 32
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Granny Mobile - EP 33
programme.desc: Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Grudge Match - EP 11
programme.desc: Raul, the Brazilian tank engine, wants to beat Thomas in a game. But Raul's super-competitive nature soon gets him into trouble.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Diesel Glows Away - EP 12
programme.desc: When notorious Diesel hides from the other engines, his plans backfire and he gets a surprise on Sodor.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Laid Back Shane - EP 13
programme.desc: Shane is having too much fun to stop and refuel. That is, until he runs out of coal and is stranded in the hot, red desert.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Stop Those Superweeds - EP 34
programme.desc: Some fast-growing plants that don't belong on Academy Island are in danger of taking over. Can the Go Jetters stop the superweed from damaging the Academy and Grim HQ?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - The Blarney Stone, Ireland - EP 35
programme.desc: Glitch finally pushes the Grimbots too far with his rudeness, prompting them to go on strike. Glitch seeks help from Kyan - but Kyan has his own problems, as he's worried about speaking in front of a crowd for his upcoming show and tell. Glitch thinks of a solution to both their problems: they'll travel to Barney Castle in Ireland, near where his Great Aunt Cliodhna lived, and find the Barney Stone. It is said to give the gift of the gab to all who kiss it, making them brilliant at talking to pe

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Around The World In 80 Days - EP 36
programme.desc: It's a rainy day and the team are stuck inside, so Foz reads them his favourite book: Around the World in 80 Days by Jules Verne. The Go Jetters imagine they are characters from the story as they listen to a tale of travel by train, boat and even elephant. Will 'Phileas Foz' and his friends make the trip in time?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Swoppiton Speed Scramble - EP 28
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo join the big cross-town race with plans to win. But how can they stay ahead when they have to keep stopping and swopping to help other racers in trouble?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Flap Away Home - EP 29
programme.desc: When a lost bird takes a liking to Bo, it is up to Mojo to fly it home. But it's a stormy trip, and Bo will need to do some flying of his own!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Evil Peamobile Goes Rogue - EP 38
programme.desc: Evil Pea adds a voice control feature to her Evil Peamobile, but when she calls it a nitwit, the car decides to teach her a lesson.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Captain Pak Choi Returns - EP 37
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are in a race against Captain Pak Choi to find buried treasure on Shiny Things Island, but they soon realise that it is one big trick by Evil Pea.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Veggie Birthday Song - EP 6
programme.desc: Supertato and the Tato Team have a veggie birthday song for you. Sing and dance along!

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - How to be a Nitwit Superhero Song - EP 7
programme.desc: Evil Pea is tired of everyone always cheering for Supertato. In this song she looks at all the things that make Supertato super, but realises that she loves being evil!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Duck Badge - EP 2
programme.desc: The clubhouse is inundated with stray ducklings who think Norrie is their mum, so Duggee and the Squirrels need to do some detective work to reunite them with their real mum.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Day Off Badge - EP 3
programme.desc: It's Duggee's Day Off but it's not long before the Squirrels show up to tell him about their adventures on their own days off... earning their Day Off badges in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Camouflage Badge - EP 4
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a chameleon called Cosey and learn about how to blend into their surroundings, earning their Camouflage Badges in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Get Indoors Badge - EP 5
programme.desc: A weather warning from Duggee's barometer leads the Squirrels to round up all the creatures they can find outside and pile into the clubhouse for an impromptu party.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - I'm Hungry - EP 5
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Potato Time - EP 6
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Song of Peace - EP 7
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Squirrel Babies - EP 8
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with, Hennie bounces around in new dance shoes, and Happy loves water as much as Roly loves potatoes!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ladybird's Gameshow - EP 9
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bad Mood - EP 39
programme.desc: Bingo is playing Bad Mood with Dad, standing on his feet as Dad stomps around the house, controlling everything Bingo does and causing chaos.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Octopus - EP 40
programme.desc: When Chloe tries to teach her dad to improvise and play Bluey's game of Octopus at home, he finds it hard to understand or enjoy, until they both realize they can play it their own way.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bin Night - EP 41
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Dad always take out the bins. Over a few weeks, Bingo tells Dad about a new kid at kindy who is mean to her and Mum offers some good advice.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Muffin Cone - EP 42
programme.desc: When Muffin can't stop sucking her thumb, she has to wear a cone of shame. But the cone gets in her way and she can no longer play `sandwich shop' with Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Hide-and-Seek, the Giant Pacific Octopus - EP 5
programme.desc: Bebefinn is playing hide and seek, just like the Giant Pacific Octopus does!

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Giraffe, The Tallest Animal on Land - EP 1
programme.desc: Finn and family find out all there is to know about giraffes.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Baby Kangaroos - EP 10
programme.desc: In this episode Andy, Jen and Scout head to Australia on a baby animal mission to solve the mystery of why a group of kangaroos, and their joeys, are living on a beach. Along the way, Andy is chased by a pack of dingoes and hops to safety with the baby kangaroos.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Three - EP 106
programme.desc: Laa-Laa has fun counting to three; 1, 2, 3 rabbits, 1, 2, 3 flowers and 1, 2, 3 trees! Laa­Laa even counts three Teletubbies; Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S03 - Swing - EP 14
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'swing' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see all sorts of swings - a red swing, a black swing, a forward and back swing. There's a tyre swing, a basket swing, a flower swing and even a rainbow swing! Not to mention King Banana on his brilliant banana swing. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S03 - Space Cucumber - EP 20
programme.desc: A copycat space seed crash lands on Farmer Fuddles's farm, and Messy is keen to help. It soon grows into... Messy! Can there ever be such a thing as too much Messy? OKIDO is about to find out.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Turbo Ted - EP 33
programme.desc: Ted the bus wants to be faster, and Mojo swops every top to try to make it happen. But it's Bo's homemade rocket that gives Ted the boost he needs... all the way into space!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon - EP 41
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Show and Tell - EP 42
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Cheerleading Badge - EP 11
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge - EP 10
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Say Cheese - EP 15
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Night And Day - EP 14
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Himalayan Heroes, Nepal - EP 11
programme.desc: Hoping to follow in his great-aunt's footsteps, Glitch enlists the help of a sceptical Foz and a friendly yak in order to find a yeti in the Himalayas.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Creek - EP 29
programme.desc: Bored of the local playground, Dad and the kids go out bushwalking on a journey to their local creek. Cast out of her comfort zone, Bluey's eyes are opened to the beauty of the natural world.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Road Trip - EP 45
programme.desc: Mum helps Bluey and Bingo find ways to entertain themselves on a family road trip, while Dad tries to stay ahead of the grey nomad convoy or risk camping near the toilets.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Mini Bluey - EP 6
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Unicorse - EP 7
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Mischevous Dino - EP 6
programme.desc: Andy returns from an adventure to find his sleeping quarters are unusually messy and discovers a small unidentified dinosaur rifling through his things.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Cats - EP 11

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Medicine Badge - EP 16

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Pizza Badge - EP 15

You can't play with it; you can play IN it says Hennie.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - King - EP 113
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, Dipsy is King. Tinky Winky delivers Tubby Custard and Tubby Toast to King Dipsy - whatever King Dipsy wants! Luckily for Tinky Winky they soon swap places.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S04 - Octopus - EP 1
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'octopus' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a giant octopus, a tiny octopus, a swimming octopus and a gardening octopus!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Moon Landing - EP 1
programme.desc: Messy accidentally drops his jam sandwich, but why did it fall down and not up? He goes to OKIDO and rockets up to the moon to find out.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Nine Legged Bill - EP 40
programme.desc: Cap'n Gail's tall tale of a nine-legged octopus in Lake Swoppiton has everyone panicking. But Mojo and Bo wonder: is the story real, or is Cap'n Gail up to something?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom - EP 1
programme.desc: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Surprise! - Bluey special trilogy episode 3 - EP 50
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want dad to play two different games, so dad tries to play both at the same time. While also watching the race on TV.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The In Charge Badge - EP 18
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The World Record - EP 17
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee's" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ping Pong Penguins - EP 22
programme.desc: What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Splash Dash - EP 21
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Shopping Shenanigans, Istanbul, Turkey - EP 18
programme.desc: In Istanbul's Grand Bazaar, Glitch wishes he could buy everything. Hearing about the wishes granted by the Hen's Eye Column in an underground water store, the Basilica Cistern, Glitch heads beneath the earth and brings the entire cistern close to collapse!

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Backpackers - EP 36
programme.desc: Mum and Dad are going on an adventure wearing the kids as their cheeky backpacks! Seeing the sights and buying street food, backpacking is a blast - until they lose their passports.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Easter - EP 52
programme.desc: It's the night before Easter and Bluey and Bingo are worried the Easter bunny is going to forget about them like last year. Mum and Dad reassure the girls but when they wake up to no chocolate eggs, Bingo fears the worst. Luckily Bluey finds a series of clues and a treasure hunt throughout the house begins.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pass the Parcel - EP 13
programme.desc: Lucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle, but Bingo is forever losing.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Perfect - EP 14
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Dino Poop - EP 13
programme.desc: Jen is studying the poop of different dinosaurs on the island, so Andy heads out on an epic adventure to collect some samples. Along the way, he meets an Alamosaurus.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Bubbles - EP 18
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun blowing and popping bubbles. In the Cloud Kitchen, all the bubbles give Patch an idea for a tasty treat - blast off melon rockets!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Theatre Badge - EP 23
programme.desc: Tino and Eugene are having a disagreement about an amateur dramatic show they want to put on. One wants an all singing all dancing extravaganza while the other, a serious drama. Can Duggee and the squirrels help them get something ready to perform?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Shadow Badge - EP 22

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Collecting Badge - EP 21
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The squirrels are inspired to make their own collections. They busy themselves doing the collecting bit, and then display their precious things in the clubhouse.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Gliding, Argentina - EP 25
programme.desc: The Go Jet cadets are taking to the skies in Argentina in an attempt to pass their academy gliding test. As gliders do not have engines, Xuli is teaching two other pilot cadets how to glide using thermals to keep them up in the air. Not wanting to miss out on the aerial action, Grandmaster Glitch gatecrashes the flying lesson in his Grim Glider! Not only has his glider got an engine, but he also wants to make the lesson into a race. Not cool...

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Valley Of The Balls, Kazakhstan - EP 24
programme.desc: The Go Jetters travel to the Valley of Balls in Kazakhstan, where they find thousands of rocks which are almost perfectly round. programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Bug Hotel - EP 47
